text_block_list.text:
On the way back from our outing, Tanino 
Gimlet suddenly brought up wanting to 
visit an art museum.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Two-headed invitation tickets... Resting 
deep within my pocket, their existence has 
now reawakened from beyond the veil of 
memory. A fine opportunity—let us answer 
the call of the god of art together."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, good day. What a coincidence to run 
into you in a place like this."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Well, well, the Emerald Noble. Good day 
to you. I see you have your imperial guard 
with you as well..."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, have you two checked out the main 
exhibit yet? Would you like to look around 
together if you'd like?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: —Oh? This abstract painting... Mmmmmm...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: It's upside down.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I saw this painting at another art museum 
a few years ago. Yes, I'm certain of it.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oh no, I have to let her know secretly...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Wait... "Why is it upside down?" That is 
the question.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"A meaningful anomaly that only Fine could 
notice... Is this a metaphor... No."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: This must be some kind of message!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
A message? What do you mean by that, 
Gimlet?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Listen. It is clear that someone's hand 
was at play here. The mystery laid before 
us can sometimes be the prologue to an 
incident."
choice_data_list: Does that mean, in other words...?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
It's elementary. This swirl pattern at the 
bottom right... Doesn't it look like the 
"emerald green" is swallowing a figure?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The key is that this is "upside down"...! 
Which means... the one swallowed up is the 
Emerald Noble. That's what it means...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Yes! This hints at the next victim! Which 
means... Fine Motion! It's an advance 
notice that you're the target!

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text: —Is that true!?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Captain! Everyone, too... Eek!

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text:
All units, Formation Delta! Surround Her 
Highness! Team C, secure the evacuation 
route—!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Don't let your guard down! There's no 
telling where the culprit might be 
lurking...!

Look out...! Everyone scrambled to shield 
Fine Motion, getting into defensive 
stances. But...!

text_block_list.name: Museum Staff
text_block_list.text:
"—Director, it's this painting. Could it 
be someone's prank? Good grief, the moment 
I turned my back...!"

text_block_list.name: Museum Director
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, you're right. When I checked earlier, 
it was definitely facing the right way, 
though...? Ah, excuse me, customer. I'll 
have it fixed right away..."

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text:
............ All personnel, stand down 
from emergency alert. Return to standard 
security duty.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: My... Or so they say, Gimlet.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh... Looks like that was a 
needless worry. What quite the plot twist.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
However, that sudden flash of inspiration 
shown by my little grey cells will never 
fade!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
A detective must always keep their eyes 
peeled for every possible lead, after all! 
Wahahahaaa!

Even though his deduction was totally 
off... Tanino Gimlet burst into hearty, 
grandiose laughter. Well, in any case...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Ah, what matters most is that the Noble 
Emerald is safe and sound.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
And so... the truth was brought to light. 
"No foul play was involved"... that is.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Quod erat demonstrandumâ proof complete. 
Once the mystery is solved, the detective 
simply departs.

She coolly headed toward the exit after 
saying that. I hurriedly chased after her 
retreating figure...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Good grief, I ended up dancing to the tune 
of quite a ridiculous farce.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Still, a minor case like this isn't bad 
once in a while. A great detective needs 
to take a breather, after all...

"She simply shrugged her shoulders, 
speaking as if handling major cases was 
just her everyday routine..."
